features.name: Gateway Circuit Breaker
features.description: In-memory per-connection circuit breaker in the Gateway request path: every failed provider attempt (credential, quota, 4xx, 5xx, network, timeout) feeds a rolling error-percentage window; open connections are filtered in memory before the provider_health_summary check, whose reads are TTL-cached; half-open trial calls close or reopen the circuit automatically; transient failures (network/timeout/5xx before first byte) retry the same provider connection with a configurable retry count (GATEWAY_PROVIDER_RETRIES = extra retries after the initial call); the streaming connect timeout default is 10s; the existing credential-failure probe enqueue is preserved.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-circuit-breaker.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/gateway-circuit-breaker.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-21: TDD red-to-green. cockatiel 4.0.0 per-connection breaker registry (packages/gateway-runtime/src/gateway-circuit-breaker.ts) — SamplingBreaker error-% window with an exact min-request volume gate, halfOpenSampling trials, onBreak/onReset/onHalfOpen logging; every provider attempt in executeProviderFallbackAttempts is routed through the registry, a BrokenCircuitError becoming a synthetic provider_circuit_open attempt that advances to the next credential; breaker-first connection filtering runs in credential assembly ahead of the provider_health_summary check, whose reads are TTL-cached in memory keyed by databaseUrl (GATEWAY_HEALTH_SUMMARY_CACHE_TTL_MS, default 5s, 0 disables); transient failures (network/timeout/5xx before first byte) retry the same connection via a wrapped cockatiel retry (GATEWAY_PROVIDER_RETRIES, default 2 extra retries after the initial call), which changed the streaming 5xx fallback e2e call-count from 1 to 3; stream connect timeout default 30s → 10s; breaker state is memory-only and resets on process restart; the existing gateway_credential_error probe enqueue is preserved. 12 unit tests across 4 describes (env, registry, fallback integration, credential filtering) and 2 E2E (breaker trips to the fallback provider and recovers through half-open with in-memory filtering; transient provider errors retry the same connection before falling back) passed. pnpm run verify (403 unit + build, EXIT=0) and verify:features (18/18, zero regression) passed. 2026-07-21 boundary/negative backfill: floored GATEWAY_BREAKER_WINDOW_MS at 1000ms (Math.max clamp in gateway-env.ts) so sub-second windows can't round SamplingBreaker's bucket size to zero and void the volume gate; grew the unit suite from 12 to 20 tests (added success-ratio strict-> boundary, half-open single-trial concurrency queuing, real-failure/circuit-open/success chain interleave via a 429 credential-class key, cache TTL=0 bypass, natural TTL expiry refresh, multi-database cache-key isolation, and local + OAuth-subscription open-breaker connection filtering) and the E2E suite from 2 to 3 (streaming requests trip the breaker and are memory-filtered to the fallback). features.name: Provider OAuth Device Code
features.description: Adds the device/user-code + PKCE + polling OAuth flow (MiniMax shape, not RFC 8628) as shared infrastructure and closes the MiniMax Coding Plan login loop: a 0003 migration persists pending_user_code/pending_verification_uri/pending_interval_seconds plus a flow_type discriminator on provider_oauth; the ProviderOAuthConfig registry type becomes a presence-discriminated union (authorization_code vs device_code) and a new minimax_coding subscription provider (base https://api.minimax.io/anthropic/v1, deviceCodeUrl https://api.minimax.io/oauth/code, tokenUrl https://api.minimax.io/oauth/token, scope group_id profile model.completion) joins the registry with quotaSource not yet supported; requestProviderOAuthUserCode posts the PKCE challenge and rewrites the verification host, pollProviderOAuthUserCodeToken judges pending/success/error from the response body status and reuses normalizeTokenBody only on success, which also gains an expires_in ?? expired_in fallback and captures resource_url into the token blob's resourceUrl (round-tripped through both readProviderOAuthTokenBlob sites); the Console start service clears earlier pending device rows, stores the user code, and drives a one-time client dialog that displays the code + verification URI and polls the new action=poll route to complete, and a device-flow guard blocks completeProviderOAuthAuthorization from exchanging a device row with the authorization-code grant.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/provider-management.unit.test.ts tests/features/platform-security.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/console-layout-interactions.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-22: TDD red-to-green for the local Batch 2 device-code plan (Feature A = steps 0, 1, 3). Step 0: migration 0003_provider_oauth_device.sql adds pending_user_code/pending_verification_uri/pending_interval_seconds + flow_type (default authorization_code, CHECK in {authorization_code, device_code}); three-way pin kept aligned (SQL file, shippedSqlMigrations checksum 5ce2de90…, platform-foundation migration-manifest assertion). ProviderOAuthConfig became a presence-discriminated union (AuthorizationCodeProviderOAuthConfig with authorizeUrl/redirectUri vs DeviceCodeProviderOAuthConfig with deviceCodeUrl/defaultPollIntervalSeconds, mutually exclusive via ?: never) so existing entries' snapshots stay byte-identical; buildProviderOAuthAuthorizeUrl/exchangeProviderOAuthCode narrow via requireAuthorizationCodeOAuthConfig. Registry gained minimax_coding (subscription; base https://api.minimax.io/anthropic/v1; endpoints {messages}; modelListEndpoint models; behavior connectivityProbeStyle anthropic + subscription + subscriptionAdapter minimax_anthropic + quotaSource {reason:not_supported,supported:false} — Feature B flips it to supported with the quota probe; oauth clientId 78257093…, deviceCodeUrl https://api.minimax.io/oauth/code, tokenUrl https://api.minimax.io/oauth/token, scope 'group_id profile model.completion', tokenEncoding form, defaultPollIntervalSeconds 2). Wiring: KnownProviderKey +1, subscriptionProviderKeys carrier +minimax_coding, knownProviderKeys +1 (after minimax), providerTemplateSelectorOrder +1 (subscription cluster after claude_code), ProviderSubscriptionAdapter +minimax_anthropic, SubscriptionProviderTemplateId +minimax_coding, new providerUsesDeviceCodeOAuth helper. Pins updated in the same change: registry snapshot +entry / length 18->19 / listSubscriptionProviderKeys +minimax_coding / listProviderTemplateEntries +1; provider-quota unsupported +minimax_coding (not_supported) and remoteKeys 15->16; console-provider-templates subscription group +minimax_coding and a shape assertion; feature_list provider-metadata-registry description 15->19 / two->three. Step 1: requestProviderOAuthUserCode posts the PKCE challenge to deviceCodeUrl and rewrites the verification host (www.minimax.io->platform.minimax.io on /oauth-authorize); pollProviderOAuthUserCodeToken posts the user_code grant and maps status (error/non-2xx -> error, non-success -> pending, success -> normalize); normalizeTokenBody gained an expires_in ?? expired_in fallback (hits both poll success and refresh) and captures resource_url into the token blob's new optional resourceUrl, round-tripped through both readProviderOAuthTokenBlob sites (console-provider-oauth + gateway-provider-credentials). Step 3: providers.ts createProviderOAuthDevicePendingConnection + deletePendingProviderOAuthDeviceConnections + pending read extended with flow_type/pending_user_code; startProviderOAuthConnection returns a discriminated (authorization_code | device_code) result and dispatches device providers to a service that first clears earlier pending device rows; pollProviderOAuthDeviceAuthorization enforces expiry locally, polls once, and completes; completeProviderOAuthAuthorization rejects device rows (provider_oauth_device_flow); route.ts adds action=poll (JSON) and device query params; a one-time client dialog (provider-oauth-device-dialog-client.tsx, driven only by start-redirect query params) shows the code + verification URI, polls, and shows a completed state, wired into providers-section behind providerUsesDeviceCodeOAuth. Tests: new tests/features/provider-oauth-device.unit.case.ts (engine body/status/rewrite/interval/resource_url/expired_in on poll+refresh; DB migration idempotency + flow_type CHECK + defaults; device start/clear-old/poll-to-complete with resource_url round-trip; expired-without-upstream; complete-guard) imported into provider-management.unit.test.ts; console device-code E2E appended to console-providers-ia-and-forms.e2e.case.ts (display code + verification link, page.route-intercepted poll pending->complete, no overflow at 1280/390). Explicitly NOT in this feature (Feature B): the minimax_anthropic egress adapter/dialect/gateway-messages dispatch, gateway-fallback-chain per-token baseUrl consumption, and the coding_plan quota probe. pnpm run verify EXIT=0 (lint+typecheck+436 unit+build, coverage above thresholds); pnpm run verify:features 21/21 zero regression. Review follow-up (3 should-fix, TDD red-first): (1) completeProviderOAuthConnection now nulls pending_user_code/pending_verification_uri/pending_interval_seconds too (no-op for authorization-code rows, which never set them) — asserted by the complete-clears-columns check in provider-oauth-device.unit.case.ts; (2) pollProviderOAuthUserCodeToken catches transient network/parse throws and returns pending (bounded by pending_expires_at) while an explicit body status 'error' stays an error whose message is read from the response body (error_description/error/message), never 'failed with status 200' — asserted by the reject->pending and status-error-message unit cases; (3) the poll route returns { status, message } and the dialog surfaces that message in its error state (with an added active recheck after response.json) — asserted by a new console E2E that intercepts poll with a body error and checks the concrete message renders and polling stops. Post-fix pnpm run verify EXIT=0 and the feature verification command EXIT=0 (unit 82 + console spec 10).
